free_tier.stated: 16 TB on NVMe-cached HDD RAID-60 (500 GB / 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 / 16 TB)

egress.terms: Bandwidth scales to 5x storage: 16TB plan = 80 TB/mo; 1TB plan = 5 TB/mo. Byte cap, not unmetered. Page footer claims "10 Gbps Connectivity".

interface_detail: SSH, FTP, FTPS, SFTP, rsync; DirectAdmin panel; Nextcloud 1-click
chaining: rsync target for archive tier; too RAM-poor for Nextcloud-in-front
limits_note: 5x-storage monthly bandwidth cap; ~100 MB/s I/O ceiling reported by buyers
reliability_note: Forum reality check: LET buyers report the '10 Gbps' is not delivered (480 Mbps measured), a 100 MB/s I/O cap, and one thread reports a storage box down 10 days during a server upgrade. German location.
